The illustration must capture the entry's ideas clearly and completely so that a reader who only saw the picture would understand what the entry is about.

1. Agent = system that observes surroundings through sensors/data inputs
2. Operates with autonomy (unlike passive calculator)
3. Has goals (explicit or learned)
4. Chooses actions to reach goals
5. Actions can be virtual (email, stock trading) or physical (robot grasping bottle, wheeling luggage)
6. Spectrum of initiative: basic (fixed rules) to advanced/autonomous (planning ahead, adapting, interacting with people/other machines)
7. The loop: perceive → decide → act → repeat
8. Central idea: turning thought into action, separating AI model on screen from machine that actually does something

The illustration needs to convey all of this visually. I should imagine a single image that shows:

- Maybe a contrast with a passive calculator
